B0FSKFCKTB.title: NEO Z-Wave Plus 700 Water Leak Sensor with Probe, Water Leak Detetor, Home Assistant & Hubitat, for Home Security, Instant alerts & App Notification; Requires a Z-Wave hub (not Included)
bullets: [PREVENT EXPENSIVE WATER DAMAGE] Reliable Leak Detection Don't let a dripping sink or burst pipe turn into a $10,000 repair bill. Designed for high-risk zones like basements, laundry rooms, and under bathroom cabinets, this water leak sensor detects even small amounts of water instantly. It serves as your 24/7 digital watchman, protecting your home valuables and flooring from disastrous floods；

T ALERTS ANYWHERE] Know Before It Floods Water damage is time-sensitive. Whether you are at work or on vacation, receive immediate push notifications or email alerts via your smart home app (e.g., Home Assistant, Hubitat) the moment a leak is detected. Gain total peace of mind knowing you'll be the first to know, allowing you to act fast before minor leaks become major headaches；

[ADVANCED HOME AUTOMATION] Trigger Sirens & Shut-off Valves Unleash the full power of Z-Wave technology. Create advanced automation routines: when water is detected, automatically trigger a loud alarm siren to alert family members, or link it with a smart water valve to automatically shut off the main water supply. This is true smart home protection that acts even when you sleep；

[UPDATED Z-WAVE PLUS 700 SERIES] Stronger Signal & Longer Battery(CR2) Say goodbye to connection drops common with Wi-Fi sensors. The upgraded 700 Series chip ensures superior wireless range, penetrating thick walls and reaching deep corners like basements or attics. Enjoy faster transmission speeds and significantly improved battery life (up to 5 years), ensuring your leak detector is always online and ready；

[FLEXIBLE & EASY INSTALLATION] Fits Anywhere Requires a Z-Wave Hub to operate (sold separately). With its compact design and flexible mounting options, you can easily place this sensor next to washing machines, water heaters, or toilets. The sensitive probe detects water levels as low as 0.5mm, minimizing false alarms while catching real threats early；
